_doc: English string table. Copy to <lang>.json and translate values; keys stay the same. {name} = player name.
inn_greet_1: Morning, {name}! The kettle's on and the guests are hungry.
inn_greet_2: Every carrot you grow ends up making someone's day. Isn't that something?
inn_greet_3: I polished the bell on the door. Twice. It's going to be a good day.
inn_l2: Level 2 already! I've cleared a spot in the Shop. You can buy more land now.
inn_l5: Wren's been talking about some sort of 'online market'. Go and see her, I can't keep up!
inn_l10: Juniper says the valley is ready for hens. I hear clucking in my dreams.
inn_l15: Do you know, people come from two towns over just for your cooking now?
inn_l20: We can finally open the guest rooms upstairs! Blankets and pillows, please. Lots of them.
inn_l25: Grandmother would never believe how busy the old inn is. I think she'd be proud of you.
inn_l30: The mayor asked if the Harvest Inn could host the autumn festival. I said yes before he finished.
inn_l40: Forty levels! I'm running out of nice things to say, so here: you're the best farmer in the kingdom.
inn_l50: Level fifty. A whole valley fed, rested and happy. Take a day off, {name}. The kettle can wait.
inn_unlock_delivery: The village has posted orders on the board by the gate. Fill them for a bonus!
inn_unlock_rooms: Guest rooms are open! Furnish them with blankets and pillows and they'll pay rent while you sleep.
inn_unlock_land: There's a bit of new land up for sale. More room for more vegetables!
chef_greet_1: Ah, {name}! Bring me good things and I will make them sing.
chef_greet_2: Taste this. No, wait, it needs more love. And possibly thyme.
chef_unlock_generic: I've worked out a new recipe! Come and look in the kitchen.
chef_unlock_soup: Tomato soup! The soup of kings, of children and of tired couriers.
chef_unlock_salad: Crisp lettuce at last! I shall make a salad so fresh it will apologise.
chef_unlock_pasta: With Rory's flour and your sauce I can make pasta. Real pasta! I may weep.
chef_unlock_eggs: Eggs! Do you know what I can do with eggs? Everything. I can do everything.
chef_unlock_dairy: Milk in the kitchen means pancakes. Pancakes mean happy guests. Simple mathematics.
chef_unlock_feast: The Harvest Feast. My masterpiece. It will need every workshop you have.
mer_greet_1: Fresh prices, fresh gossip! What are you selling today?
mer_greet_2: Pumpkins are up in the east valley. Don't ask me how I know.
mer_unlock_online: Big news! The traders' network is open. You can sell to farmers far beyond the valley. Set your own price!
mer_unlock_friends: Make some farmer friends! Share your friend code and you can visit and help each other.
mer_l8: Strawberries sell like hot pies. Or you could make hot pies. Up to you!
mer_l16: Tip from an old trader: check the price chart before you list. Buy low, smile a lot.
vet_greet_1: Hello! Everyone's had their breakfast and a scratch behind the ears.
vet_greet_2: Happy animals give more. Feed them, pet them, and tell them they're doing great.
vet_unlock_chicken: Hens are ready to move in! Build a coop and they'll give you eggs and the odd feather.
vet_unlock_coop: A coop is a home, not a box. Keep it cosy and your hens will thank you.
vet_unlock_cow: Cows! Gentle, patient, and very fond of feed. Their milk makes butter, cream and cheese.
vet_unlock_goat: Goats have arrived. They're clever, so lock the feed bin. Goat milk makes cheese and soap.
vet_unlock_sheep: Sheep at last! A quick, painless trim gives soft wool. They look adorable afterwards.
cra_greet_1: Hm. You've come to see the gears. Good. They like visitors.
cra_greet_2: Measure twice, cut once, have a biscuit.
cra_unlock_mill: The old windmill is ready. Wheat goes in, flour comes out. Mind your fingers.
cra_unlock_bakery: I've built you a bakery. The oven is temperamental, like all good ovens.
cra_unlock_jam: Jam kitchen's done. Bring berries. Leave the wasps.
cra_unlock_craft: A craft table for feathers and odds and ends. Pillows don't stuff themselves.
cra_unlock_dairy: The dairy has butter churns and cheese presses. I tested the churn. Made butter. Ate the butter.
cra_unlock_soap: Soap maker's ready. Goat milk and herbs. Smells like a meadow after rain.
cra_unlock_loom: The loom house is finished. Wool to yarn, yarn to blankets. Very soothing clatter.
g_tob_arrive: A bowl of something warm for an old walker?
g_tob_served: That's going in my next story. The good part.
g_pip_arrive: The light here is perfect. So is the smell from your kitchen!
g_pip_served: I'll paint this plate. Then I'll eat it. Then I'll paint the empty plate.
g_oda_arrive: Helianthus annuus everywhere! Also, I'm famished.
g_zur_arrive: Quick quick, I've got six letters left and an empty stomach!
g_zur_served: Fuel! Thank you! Gone! Back tomorrow!
g_lyr_arrive: I'll play you a tune for a slice of pie. Two slices, two tunes.
g_lyr_served: ♪ The Harvest Inn, the Harvest Inn, the finest food I've ever been in ♪
g_mil_arrive: Excuse me, may I see the menu? I'm researching.
g_mil_served: The crust is excellent. I've written it down.
g_had_arrive: Ahoy! Is this an inn or a lighthouse? Either way I'm hungry.
g_had_served: Best catch of the day, and it's not even fish!
g_yoo_arrive: Let's see what this young farmer can grow.
g_yoo_served: Hm. Very good. Here, take these seeds. Don't tell anyone.
g_ash_arrive: A quiet table, if you have one. And soup, if you have that too.
g_ash_served: Steam rises like a sigh / the spoon, a small sun / I'll be back.
g_pur_arrive: Oh, what a lovely inn! Is that blanket hand-made?
g_pur_served: Delightful, dear. I'm knitting you a tea cosy.
tut_welcome: Welcome to the valley! I'm Marigold, and this old inn is ours. Use the joystick on the left to walk around. Let's make you a farmer.
tut_plant: Lovely soil! Stand on a plot and tap Plant. Wheat grows in under a minute. Hold the button and walk across the field to plant every plot.
tut_cook: While it grows, come to the inn: talk to Basil by the kitchen and cook a Carrot Stew. You already have the carrots!
tut_harvest: Your wheat is golden and glowing: walk to it and tap Harvest!
tut_serve: A guest is waiting! Walk into the inn and serve them that stew. Listen to those coins!
tut_sell: Psst! Over here at my market stall, west of the square. Come sell me something; prices change every day.
tut_done: That's the farming life: buy land, grow, cook, serve, sell. Here's a little gift. Welcome home, {name}!
tut_buy: Every farmer needs land. Walk down the lane to the FOR SALE field and tap the green button to buy it for 20 coins.
